corrected_primary_source.exact_interpretation: Slide 22 reports Q3 stablecoin revenue of $307M (+5% Q/Q). Slide 9 reports $22B average USDC held in Coinbase products and $51B average off-platform USDC balances. The official deck does not support the previously stated $202M/$126M revenue split.

circle_side_unchanged.comparability: Circle distribution costs and Coinbase stablecoin revenue are different accounting measures. The arithmetic difference of -$24.3M is not Coinbase profit/loss, Circle margin, or a reconciliation.

correction_reason: The prior artifact treated an unverified search-result extraction as an on-platform/off-platform revenue split. The primary SEC earnings exhibit explicitly reports $307M total Q3 stablecoin revenue and separately reports USDC balance metrics. The revenue split is withdrawn.

source_receipts.excerpt: Q3 2026 Coinbase stablecoin revenue was $307 million, up 5% quarter over quarter. The earnings deck attributes growth to a new all-time high in average USDC held in Coinbase products and higher interest rates, partially offset by off-platform balances.

Q3 2026 average USDC held in Coinbase products was $22 billion; average off-platform USDC balances were $51 billion. The deck does not disclose a $202 million on-platform and $126 million off-platform stablecoin revenue split.
During the third quarter of 2026, Coinbase renewed its arrangement with Circle on the same terms; the average amount of USDC held on Coinbase products reached an all-time high during the quarter.

Q3 2026 Coinbase-related distribution costs $331.3 million; nine months ended September 30, 2026 Coinbase-related distribution costs $986.6 million; average USDC circulation $73.264 billion; September 30 USDC circulation $73.879 billion; USDC on Circle's platform $13.868 billion.
